The revenue build does clear the $265m bar, but this name demonstrably does not pay for revenue (Q4 beat by 14% and fell 5.5%) and the two findings that hit what it does pay for both cut negative: share count 136.2M to 147.8M in two months off the 10-K cover and the proxy record date, i.e. 8.5% dilution nobody aggregates, and ~GBP50m poured into a BrewDog that management says is cash-flow positive only in 2027 against FY26 adjusted FCF of -$86m; shrunk toward flat because 14.4% of float is short at the lows with a -4.36 call-bid skew.
